caveats: ⚑ Hit Rate ▲30.37% (burst, self, 15s): the kit percentage is literal, but its damage consequence is the engine's Hit-Rate→core-lift conversion (hrCoreMult), which is a derived/measured quantity, not a kit value. Aria's whole self-damage upside from her burst rides on that unmeasured conversion.

⚑ MG cadence tuple (rate_of_fire / reloadFrames 161 / ammo 300 / hitsPerShot 1) is datamine-sourced and known-unreliable; it sets how often skill2's lastBullet trigger fires, so the team-wide Critical Rate ▲7.03%/5s UPTIME is cadence-derived, not kit-stated. An MG magazine of 300 with MG wind-up means very few magazine cycles per 180s fight — skill2 uptime is likely low and sensitive to the cadence numbers.

Shield (burst, all allies, 37.86% of caster final Max HP, 10s) carries no HP pool at scope lock, but is NOT skipped: it emits shield events that fire teammates' `shielded` triggers / satisfy `requiresShielded` gates (tandem rule).
`allies` target includes self (no excludeSelf in either kit line — neither skill1 nor skill2 says 'except self'), so Aria receives her own Crit Damage / Crit Rate buffs.
skill1 is keyed `fullBurstEnter`, not `burstCast`: the text says 'at the beginning of Full Burst', so it fires on ANY team Full Burst, independent of whether Aria (Burst II) casts.
Both crit buffs are UNSCOPED in the prose (no 'of normal attacks' qualifier), so generic critDamagePct / critRatePct are correct — not critRateNormalPct.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Aria (MG/Water/Attacker/Burst II) is a pure crit-support kit with zero damage lines of her own: S1 grants the team Critical Damage ▲26.99%/10s at every Full Burst entry; S2 grants the team Critical Rate ▲7.03%/5s each time her last bullet hits (per-magazine, so its uptime is governed entirely by the ⚑ MG cadence tuple); her burst is a 10s team shield (37.86% of her final Max HP — no HP pool at scope lock, kept for tandem `shielded` consumers and kit completeness) plus a self Hit Rate ▲30.37%/15s whose damage effect flows through the engine's ⚑ Hit-Rate→core conversion. No flatDamage, no DoT, no weapon swap, no ammo/reload modifier, no stack or resource pool, no formation/element/status gate. Nothing in the kit is dropped: `unmodeled` is empty for all three slots.

flags.field: burst[1].effects[0] (hitRatePct 30.37) — the hitRate→core conversion, NOT the kit %
flags.estimate: Kit value 30.37 is literal and shipped as-is; the ⚑ is the engine's hrCoreMult conversion from Hit Rate points to realized core-hit rate, which is an unmeasured/derived slope for an MG at the scope-lock boss bands. First estimate: use the engine default hrCoreMult path unchanged (no per-unit override), i.e. Aria's own core rate lifts by whatever the shared curve yields for +30.37 Hit Rate over her 15s window.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ item #7: Hit-Rate→core magnitude is measured-only. Aria has no damage lines, so this self buff is the ONLY channel by which her burst changes her own damage — the whole per-unit sensitivity of this override to HRCORE sits here. MG spray at range makes the core fraction band-dependent, so a shared curve may not transfer.
flags.recipe: Record a scope-lock fight with Aria in a comp where she bursts at least twice. Count CORE HIT (red) vs plain popups in a 15s post-burst window and in a matched pre-burst window at the same boss range band; the delta in core fraction per +30.37 Hit Rate is the slope. Cross-check by running the comp with HRCORE=0 vs default and comparing Aria's sim total against the Battle Records number (ATK is class-based at scope lock — Attacker 118,027 — so magnitude is not confounded here).

flags.field: skill2 uptime — driven by the MG cadence tuple (rate_of_fire / reloadFrames 161 / ammo 300 / hitsPerShot 1)
flags.estimate: Uptime of the team Critical Rate ▲7.03% is (5s × number of magazine cycles) / fight, capped by non-overlap. With ammo 300 and MG wind-up + reload 161f (~2.68s), expect only a handful of lastBullet events across 180s, so estimate LOW uptime (order 10–25% of the fight) rather than near-continuous.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ item #1: the cadence tuple is datamine-sourced and known-unreliable (nominal rate_of_fire is not the 60fps-quantized effective rate), and MG wind-up further stretches the real magazine time. The kit gives the buff's magnitude and duration but says nothing about how often it fires — that is entirely cadence-derived. A wrong cadence changes the team-wide crit rate uptime, so this error propagates to EVERY unit in the comp, not just Aria.
flags.recipe: Read Aria's ammo counter frame-by-frame off a scope-lock recording to get her effective shots/sec directly (the ammo counter measures the disputed quantity; FB counts do not), and time one full 300→0→reloaded cycle. Compare against the sim's reload/lastBullet event stream via cfg.onEvent (kinds 'reload' / 'buffApply' with stat 'critRatePct'); count lastBullet firings per 180s in sim vs footage.

flags.field: skill1 trigger identity — fullBurstEnter vs burstCast
flags.estimate: Shipped as fullBurstEnter (fires on any team Full Burst).
flags.reasoning: The prose says 'at the beginning of Full Burst', which is the full-burst-enter wording, not 'when using Burst Skill'. Aria is Burst II, so in a normal B1→B2→B3 rotation she casts on most rotations anyway and the two keyings largely coincide — but in any comp with a SECOND Burst II unit that takes some rotations, burstCast would under-fire while fullBurstEnter stays correct. Flagged because the two diverge exactly in the multi-B2 case and the prose alone cannot rule out a hidden self-cast requirement.
flags.recipe: Run a comp with Aria plus another Burst II unit and confirm from footage that the Critical Damage ▲ buff icon appears on the team at Full Burst entry on rotations where the OTHER B2 cast, not Aria. If it only appears when Aria casts, re-key to burstCast (or fullBurstEnter + ownBurstGate:'cast').

flags.field: burst[0] shield — inertness assumption at scope lock
flags.estimate: Modeled as a shield effect emitting shield events; assumed to contribute ZERO direct damage (no HP pool, boss damage unmodeled) and to matter only via teammates' `shielded` triggers / `requiresShielded` gates.
flags.reasoning: Tandem/cross-unit rule: a shield that is inert alone can drive a teammate's shield-synergy damage. 'Inert' is itself a load-bearing premise, so it is flagged rather than asserted — its truth depends on the comp roster, not on Aria's kit.
flags.recipe: Before treating it as inert in any A/B, grep the graded comps' rosters for units with a `shielded` trigger or `requiresShielded` gate; if any co-appear with Aria, the shield is load-bearing and its block ordering vs their triggers must be checked in the rotation log.
